title: Product
description: A single item in the catalogue, as stored and as returned by the catalogue API.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit. Stable for the life of the product.

name.description: Display name, as shown in the storefront.

price.description: Current list price, before any discount.

dimensions.description: Physical size, absent for digital goods.

tags.description: Free-form labels used for search and merchandising.

discontinued.description: Whether the product may still be ordered.

replacedBy.description: SKU of the successor product, once discontinued.

Money.title: Money
Money.description: An amount in a single currency. Minor units, to avoid floating point.

amount.description: Value in the currency's minor unit, so 1250 is 12.50.

Dimensions.title: Dimensions
Dimensions.description: Packed size, used for shipping quotes.

unit.description: Unit the three lengths are given in.
